newsitem.title: USA: DLJ closes $3 bln merchant banking fund.
newsitem.headline: DLJ closes $3 bln merchant banking fund.

text.p: Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Inc said Thursday that it has closed a $3 billion merchant banking fund for private equity and equity-related investments.
DLJ said it and its employees have committed 25 percent to the fund, called DLJ Merchant Banking Partners II.

The company said the fund will make investments in stock, debt or other securities in leveraged acquisitions, corporate joint ventures and turnarounds. DLJ said the fund will also provide growth equity or mezzanine capital to private companies. Investments will range from $20 million to more than $300 million, the company said.
DLJ said its first merchant banking fund, of $1 billion, remains fully committed.
